rubric.role_summary: Senior consumer product designer shaping end-to-end experiences for an AI-powered language-learning app, including speaking practice, onboarding, retention, and subscriptions.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior consumer product designer shaping end-to-end experiences for an AI-powered language-learning app, including speaking practice, onboarding, retention, and subscriptions.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 6+ years of product design experience designing consumer products.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in language learning, education, or another domain with substantial cross-cultural product work.
- Experience using prototypes to communicate ideas and test assumptions.
- Portfolio demonstrating user-centric design and innovative interaction patterns.
- Contributions to design systems that scale beyond a single team.
- Ability to tinker directly in code.
- Experience engaging with users and synthesizing user insights to inform product strategy and direction.
- Experience using AI creatively in the design process.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.

soft_requirements: Product thinking and structured judgment; ability to frame problems and communicate a clear narrative.
Taste, craft, and judgment about when to move quickly versus invest in polish.
